data.text:
Trailer + Formats in one node

Drop your recording on the Episode Recording node, then Run Trailer. It transcribes the recording, picks the strongest moments, joins them into one 20–40 second trailer and renders it as a 720p Preview. Review it (you can edit the cut), then choose Render final on Trailer: it renders the trailer at full quality and delivers it as a 9:16 story or reel, a 1:1 square post and a 4:5 portrait post.

To skip the review, turn off Trailer's Review before render.

The intro card is optional: connect a short title-card video (15 seconds at most) to Trailer's Intro card input and it plays before the trailer. Make it the same size and shape as your recording, or one of the two is letterboxed.

Every format is padded, never cropped, so no speaker is cut off. Its settings choose the formats, a 16:9 landscape among them.

Want to adjust each step yourself? The Trailer + Formats template builds the same chain node by node.
